head_policy: Read exact G5 PR HEAD from Git after push; independently audit that SHA; authority must match it exactly. Never precompute or substitute branch name for SHA.
main_policy: Fetch origin/main before observation and execution; STOP and report Research Lead if main differs from execution_base. HEAD must be a strict descendant of execution_base; clean checkout required.
draft_pr_policy: KEEP OPEN throughout environment observation, independent environment audit, Research Lead authorization, qualification execution and human review. Merging changes main and invalidates authority. No automatic merge.
run_id_policy: Predeclared before outputs; never change in response to output. No retry or repair.
environment_contract_overlay: Keep v1 unverified and byte-unchanged. G5 observation code_and_contract_hashes uses runtime_lock.v2:sha256, replacing only the historical v1 lock reference for future observation. Hardware/software inventory and scientific controls remain unchanged.
authorization_policy: Separate external attestation after independent audit; distinct Research Lead and auditor. Template is not a signature or authorization. Any HEAD/main/environment/runtime-lock change invalidates prior approval.
